{{Quote|Better going down in flames than dying of food poisoning in that cell.|Esu|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Esu''' was a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Esu was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] alongside various other [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'' for transport to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the voyage, the bounty hunter [[Arlain Zee]] escaped from his cell and freed Esu and several other hunters. Zee, Esu, and the bounty hunters [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]], [[Kessk]] and [[M-1991]] [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|attempted]] to make their way to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay and flee the vessel, but they were soon recaptured by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
